plan: Final experiment design synthesis for the word-sorting program, delivered as a self-contained design document with the requested ten-section structure. (1) Research question and falsifiable pre-registered hypothesis H1, with the explicit negation rule that an untagged DV1 failure falsifies H1 cell-by-cell and that performance variation exceeding the timing-noise envelope is inconclusive rather than falsifying. (2) Ten-clause pre-registered canonical contract covering input format, token definition, tokenisation side-effects, ordering rule with key function str.lower, stable duplicates, single-trailing-newline output, LC_ALL=C, empty input, reference runtime Python 3.12.3, and determinism. (3) IV/DV matrix with nine semantic regimes as primary rows, three algorithm families (sorted-with-key, cmp_to_key, locale.strxfrm) as secondary columns, applicability marks yielding 26 applicable cells, and DV1 byte-equal correctness plus DV2 line-discipline plus DV3 stability as hard gates and DV4/DV5/DV6 as descriptive tie-break. (4) Regime definitions as explicit named deviations per spec clause with registry tags. (5) Harness procedure specified (driver, fixture loader, per-cell loop with one warm-up plus K=11 timed trials, tracemalloc, JSON schema) with execution explicitly out of scope and no measurements claimed. (6) Controls including oracle construction from the spec, the 14-item pre-registered edge-case battery by name, reproducibility settings (LC_ALL=C, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, fixed seed, sys.intern on tokens, content addressing), and the falsification/deviation registry. (7) Analysis plan with correctness-first gating, pre-registered recommendation rule, dual-threshold T, and no pre-committed winning margin. (8) Feasibility reiterating design-only, stdlib only, sandbox and network compatibility, size ladder {0,1,10,100,1000,10000} without any N treated as measured, and explicit hold-outs (larger N, streaming, cross-language oracle). (9) Open choices U1-U12 with fallback defaults, including U11 locale-infeasibility tagging and U12 dual-threshold tie-break. (10) Appendix enumerating every intended stdlib import. The document does not run any code and does not claim any timing or correctness outcome.

context.question: Build a word sorting program that alphabetically sorts a list of words and returns them as a single line of text with spaces between words.
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.

environment.software_environment: system Python; project dependencies not preinstalled
environment.note: Successful exploratory commands are not proof of a completed experiment.
